notes:
Login page redesign polish:
- Bigger brand mark and 2x2 feature-card grid on the left panel, wordmark moved above the login card in the center.
- New scrolling status ticker across the bottom of the login screen.
- Sign In button and card accents switched from purple to the app's blue-cyan brand gradient.
- A real "opening the app" zoom animation now plays on successful login/signup instead of an instant cut.

TDS Entries module:
- AIS JSON parser rewritten to match the real Income Tax portal export schema — now extracts every individual TDS transaction row (not just one summary per deductor).
- AIS file decryption confirmed working against a real downloaded file.
- Dr/Cr ledger pickers on the TDS Entries page are now real dropdowns sourced from Tally's live ledger list, with a Tally connection status badge.
- Picking a ledger for one row now auto-applies it to every other row for the same deductor.
